verdict.rationale: Issuing API credentials is a fair question for a hosted search API. The evidence pack only shows that requests authenticate with an application ID and an `x-algolia-api-key` header, plus browser-based CLI sign-in. Nothing in the pack covers creating scoped or restricted keys, ACLs, per-index or per-operation limits, or agent-specific credentials, so least-privilege issuance is unevidenced.
